question:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

AHO, ELS, IPW, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1e96d51b86d15421868a13329a263f32ed0009588559b082c8ac26d64b3fe09.png] 

Logic : (+4) is added in each letter's position value or next 4th letter according to English alphabetic series is written.

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c3e1ef880c20cdeda80b674726b83f00034ac051e1048ad8e8785d166b3bff0.png] 

Hence, **"MTA"** is the correct answer.
